name: Multi-plane Operation-Specific Aligned Identity Capsule
purpose: Bind the smallest operation-specific causal semantics to distinct semantic, provenance-instance, basis/epoch, selection/query-plan and reader-view identities while compiling one logical Clay data/query world onto physically specialized stores and cognition rails.
core_rule: one semantic world != one identity axis != one causal stage != one physical store
pipeline: MRSC rail planning -> canonical/discrete/latent/hybrid model view
append canonical receipt/event -> incremental derived-view maintenance

identity_axes.question: same concrete bytes/symbols/tensor envelope delivered to reader?

state_contracts.invariant: capsule describes required causal identity/closure but is not fact truth or capability; unknown scope broadens or escalates
logical plan may choose specialized engines; approximate routes cannot satisfy exact/effect-critical obligations unless exact validation follows
derived view is not truth/authority by materialization; stale/unknown status is explicit and exact fallback remains available
record provenance does not substitute for selection provenance; candidate membership is causally explicit
source identity, exact emitted view and basis are separately bound; receipt identity still does not prove semantic adequacy without validation
physical placement cannot alter canonical semantic identity or authority
future state/reward updates remain bound to the exact prior causal episode and do not retroactively rewrite its meaning

operations.rule: derive operation-specific identity/consistency/selection/projection/effect closure from committed intent + canonical state
planner may optimize routes/placement but cannot weaken capsule requirements; unknown capability/consistency/selection semantics fail closed or broaden
bind source identities/epochs, derivation semantics and exact materialized view; declare lag/rebuild recipe
bind authorized space, plan semantics, candidate membership/ranking and selected anchors
delegate to MRSC rail compiler after COVE/MOSAIC closure; bind exact reader view and required semantics coverage
revalidate only effect-relevant required consistency/selection/capability witnesses plus hard global invariants; global all-domain lock is not default
propagate canonical event deltas only through declared dependency graph; switch to partial/full rebuild when adaptive cost/recovery policy says so

incremental_policy: derived views consume canonical deltas; scope invalidation by dependency ancestry; adaptive overlay/partial/full rebuild uses measured future-read demand, query tax, memory, write amplification and recovery risk
gwt_mapping: MOSAIC capsule, UnifiedQueryPlan, SelectionReceipt and ReaderHandoff are separate causal witnesses surrounding WorkspaceEpisode. Workspace lesions must pin or independently vary them.
emergence_mapping: Every intervention/lesion/rescue/OOD episode stores exact capsule/basis/selection/view identity; recurrence across changed identities is not automatically the same mechanism.
claygraph_mapping: Graph memory remains one specialized derived view; activation is salience only. UnifiedDB can route through graph/vector/FTS/exact paths without making one retrieval modality canonical truth.
claycode_mapping: CC-RC1.6 MRSC remains reader/cognition lowering after trusted COVE/MOSAIC semantics; E2B triple-bound identity is generalized to multiple explicit identity axes rather than one super-hash.
hyperposition_mapping: Semantic, coordination, representation and physical topologies may change independently; MOSAIC records the operation-specific cross-topology witness set.
platform_mapping: Linux/Android share canonical contracts and logical planner semantics while physical engines, quantization, IPC, caches and rail selection are reader/platform versioned.
promotion_boundary: No generation promotion until target/live evidence shows semantic preservation, replay/recovery, selection integrity, operation-scoped consistency, reader performance, physical-placement economics and common-mode fault containment.
